Calculate the number-average molecular weight M_n using the formula M_n = Σ(N_i × M_i) / Σ(N_i).
The data points are: M_1 = 56526 g/mol with N_1 = 96 molecules, M_2 = 92809 g/mol with N_2 = 131 molecules, M_3 = 115856 g/mol with N_3 = 153 molecules, M_4 = 126029 g/mol with N_4 = 146 molecules.
Compute the numerator as the sum of each molecular weight multiplied by its corresponding number of molecules: (96 × 56526) + (131 × 92809) + (153 × 115856) + (146 × 126029).
Compute the denominator as the sum of all numbers of molecules: 96 + 131 + 153 + 146 = 526.
Divide the numerator by the denominator to obtain M_n.
Report the result in g/mol rounded to one decimal place.
